title: One-way C2 via web storage (Google Docs/Forms)
hypothesis: Malware uses Google Docs/Forms or similar as dead-drop resolvers.
queries: DeviceNetworkEvents | where RemoteUrl has_any ('docs.google.com','forms.gle','api.telegram.org') | where InitiatingProcessFileName not in ('chrome.exe','msedge.exe','outlook.exe')
rationale: Dead-drop resolver endpoints from odd processes.
